title: Always Late

pre.zh: 下一位打进电话的听众是谁？

intro: 一档电台情感热线：听众 Amy 打进电话诉苦，主持人 Jo 给她出主意。读的时候留意第二条件句 If I were you, I would …：明知不是真的，偏要假设一下，给建议就显得委婉。也比一比 Amy 说的 If I say something, she'll …，看两种 if 有什么不同。

sentences.en: Hello, you're on Ask Jo.
sentences.zh: 你好，这里是《问问 Jo》。
sentences.speaker: Jo

sentences.en: What's on your mind?
sentences.zh: 有什么烦心事？

sentences.en: I'm Amy, and my best friend Zara is always late.
sentences.zh: 我叫 Amy，我最好的朋友 Zara 总是迟到。
sentences.speaker: Amy

sentences.en: She keeps me waiting for half an hour, sometimes a whole hour.
sentences.zh: 她一让我等就是半小时，有时候整整一小时。

sentences.en: And she's always got an excuse.
sentences.zh: 而且每次都有借口。

sentences.en: And you're never late?
sentences.zh: 那你自己从来不迟到？
sentences.speaker: Jo

sentences.en: Never.
sentences.zh: 从来不。
sentences.speaker: Amy

sentences.en: I'm very punctual, so I usually get there first.
sentences.zh: 我特别守时，所以一般都是我先到。

sentences.en: Last Saturday she let me down again.
sentences.zh: 上周六她又掉链子了。

sentences.en: We missed the start of a film, and I nearly lost my temper in the queue.
sentences.zh: 电影开头没赶上，排队的时候我差点发火。

sentences.en: Oh dear.
sentences.zh: 哎呀。
sentences.speaker: Jo

sentences.en: Maybe I shouldn't have got so angry, but I'm fed up with it.
sentences.zh: 也许我不该那么生气，可我真的受够了。
sentences.speaker: Amy

sentences.en: Sometimes I feel left out, as if her other plans matter more.
sentences.zh: 有时候我觉得自己被冷落了，好像她别的安排都比我重要。

sentences.en: I don't want to fall out with her.
sentences.zh: 我不想跟她闹翻。

sentences.en: But her excuses are starting to get on my nerves.
sentences.zh: 可她那些借口越来越让我心烦。

sentences.en: Am I taking it too personally?
sentences.zh: 是不是我太往心里去了？

sentences.en: No, you're not — your time matters too.
sentences.zh: 没有——你的时间也很宝贵。
sentences.speaker: Jo

sentences.en: Have you told her?
sentences.zh: 你跟她说过吗？

sentences.en: Not yet.
sentences.zh: 还没有。
sentences.speaker: Amy

sentences.en: If I say something, she'll get upset.
sentences.zh: 我要是说了，她会不高兴的。

sentences.en: Well, you should have said something earlier, but it isn't too late.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你早该说的，不过现在也不晚。
sentences.speaker: Jo

sentences.en: If I were you, I'd be honest with her.
sentences.zh: 换我是你，我就跟她直说。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？
sentences.speaker: Amy

sentences.en: Really.
sentences.zh: 真的。
sentences.speaker: Jo

sentences.en: If she knew how much it hurt you, she'd try harder.
sentences.zh: 她要是知道这让你多难受，会更上心的。

sentences.en: On the other hand, if you lost your temper, she'd only defend herself.
sentences.zh: 反过来，你要是冲她发火，她只会急着替自己辩解。

sentences.en: So calm down first, and then talk to her face to face.
sentences.zh: 所以先让自己冷静下来，再当面跟她谈。

sentences.en: And tell her the friendship means a lot to you.
sentences.zh: 还要告诉她，这份友情对你很重要。

sentences.en: If I were her, I'd want to know.
sentences.zh: 换我是她，我会想知道的。

sentences.en: OK, I'll call her tonight.
sentences.zh: 好，我今晚就给她打电话。
sentences.speaker: Amy

sentences.en: And make sure you call, not text.
sentences.zh: 记得是打电话，别发消息。
sentences.speaker: Jo

sentences.en: Good luck, Amy!
sentences.zh: 祝你好运，Amy！

sentences.en: Right, next caller.
sentences.zh: 好，下一位听众。

sentences.en: Hi Jo, I'm Zara.
sentences.zh: 嗨，Jo，我是 Zara。
sentences.speaker: Zara

sentences.en: My best friend always turns up half an hour early and says I'm late!
sentences.zh: 我最好的朋友每次都提前半小时到，然后说我迟到！

cards.note: to make someone wait, usually because you are late
cards.tip: 人放在中间：keep me waiting；道歉常说 Sorry to keep you waiting 或 Sorry I kept you waiting。
cards.example: Sorry to keep you waiting — the last meeting ran over.

cards.note: 名词读 /ɪkˈskjuːs/，动词读 /ɪkˈskjuːz/；make an excuse 找借口。
名词是 punctuality；口语里也常说 always on time。
to not do what someone trusted or expected you to do
cards.tip: 人放在中间：let me down；过去式、过去分词都是 let。名词 a letdown 是「令人失望的事」。
cards.example: The team is counting on me, and I don't want to let them down.

cards.tip: your 跟着主语变：lost my temper、lost his temper；反过来「忍住不发火」是 keep your temper。
cards.example: He lost his temper when the build failed for the fifth time.

cards.note: to be annoyed or bored with something that has gone on for too long
cards.tip: with 后面接让人烦的事，也可以接 doing：fed up with waiting；口语里常单说一句 I'm fed up.
cards.example: I'm fed up with meetings that could have been an email.

cards.zh: 觉得被冷落；觉得被排除在外
cards.note: to feel that you are not included in a group or an activity
to argue with someone and stop being friendly with them
to annoy someone, especially by doing something again and again

cards.zh: 往心里去；觉得是冲着自己来的
cards.note: to feel that someone's words or actions are an attack on you, when they may not be
当动词用，主语是事情：It doesn't matter.（没关系）不要说 It's not matter。
比 angry 轻，多指心里难受；get upset 变得不高兴。
to tell someone the truth, even when it is difficult
cards.tip: 对谁坦诚用 with，不用 to；honest 的 h 不发音，前面用 an：an honest answer。
cards.example: To be honest with you, I don't think the plan will work.

cards.note: used to introduce a different or opposite point
cards.tip: 可以和 on the one hand 前后呼应，但单独用更常见；中间的 the 别漏掉。
cards.example: The job pays well. On the other hand, the hours are long.

cards.note: defend yourself 为自己辩解；名词英式拼 defence，美式拼 defense。
to stop feeling upset, angry or nervous
cards.tip: 第 13 课是对别人说 calm down；这里用 you've calmed down，强调先冷静好了，再去做下一步。
cards.example: Wait until you've calmed down before you reply to that email.

cards.note: -ship 表示关系或状态，同类的词还有 relationship、partnership。
to be very important to someone
cards.tip: 主语是那件重要的事：The friendship means a lot to me，不说 I mean a lot to the friendship。
cards.example: It would mean a lot to me if you came to the launch.

cards.note: to do or check something so that you are certain it happens
cards.tip: 后面接句子；要强调「先做完」，可以用现在完成时：make sure you've saved it。
cards.example: Make sure the tests pass before you merge.
